title: Travel Ops evaluation case
description: Schema for one line of data/eval/master.jsonl or data/eval/live_subset.jsonl. Defines the exact columns evaluators and the optimizer read. Designed to contrast a naive v1 prompt-only agent against an improved v2 agent (Foundry IQ + tools) on the same fixed question set.

query.description: Japanese-first user query presented to the agent under evaluation.

expected_behavior.description: Grader-facing description of the behavior a correct answer must exhibit (not necessarily verbatim text).

ground_truth.description: Optional reference answer or fact used for string/semantic-similarity graders. Omitted or null when the case is graded purely on behavior (e.g. refusal, clarification).

expected_citations.description: Document ids from data/manifest.json that a correct, well-grounded answer should cite.

requires_citation.description: Whether a correct answer must include an inline citation to a source document.

expected_tool_calls.description: Ordered list of tool/API invocations a correctly-behaving agent is expected to make. Omitted for pure retrieval/QA cases.

arguments.description: Expected request arguments/query params, matched by the evaluator against the agent's actual tool call arguments.

v1_expected_outcome.description: Expected grading outcome for an under-specified v1 agent (prompt-only, no tools, direct Azure AI Search retrieval without agentic multi-hop). Used to prove measurable improvement in v2.

v2_expected_outcome.description: Expected grading outcome for the improved v2 agent (Foundry IQ agentic retrieval, tools/toolbox, evaluation-informed prompt).

v1_failure_mode.description: Short note on why v1 is expected to underperform on this case (e.g. single-hop retrieval misses second document, no tool access, hallucinated numbers).

notes.description: Free-text authoring notes, not used by graders.
